summary:

What: PepsiCo (Nasdaq: PEP), one of the world's leading food and beverage companies, will ring the Nasdaq Closing Bell remotely from Atlanta to celebrate Super Bowl LIII and the Pepsi Super Bowl LIII Halftime Show.
